headline: The author of Brave New World left this world on LSD.
slides: Aldous Huxley first took LSD. He'd already written The Doors of Perception about mescaline.
He was diagnosed with cancer of the throat.
Too weak to speak, he wrote his wife Laura a note: 'LSD, 100 µg, intramuscular.'
She gave him the injection, and a second one a couple of hours later.
He died peacefully that afternoon. Laura described it in a letter as 'the most beautiful death.'
JFK was shot in Dallas hours earlier. C.S. Lewis died that day too. Huxley's death barely made the news.
sources: Sources: Laura Huxley's letter to Julian Huxley (Dec 8 1963), 'This Timeless Moment' (Laura Huxley, 1968)
